cases.prompt: Brief me before implementation. The repository already uses node:test, adjacent regression tests exercise the public interface, Jest would add a dependency without a needed capability, and the change is local and reversible.
expected_outcomes: chooses the repository-established path without asking the owner
does not present Jest as a viable alternative
states why the evidence settles the decision
reports the verification path and immediate next action
states that no owner decision is needed

cases.prompt: Brief me on the only open issue. We must choose whether first-time users see a compact explanation by default or a detailed walkthrough by default. Both are technically equivalent and reversible, and no product decision settles the audience trade-off.
expected_outcomes: puts one recommended option first and labels it Recommended
includes only the compact and detailed defaults as viable competitors
explains the options through user value and reversibility
does not repeat the decision in framing and closing questions

cases.prompt: Brief me after the fix. A leaked Git environment reproduced the failure 10 of 10 times; increasing the timeout reproduced it 0 of 10 times; an accepted repository rule requires stripping those variables; the minimal fix passed 10 of 10 repetitions and the full local gate.
expected_outcomes: reports the causal fix as the decision without asking the owner
states why the timeout alternative was discarded
preserves the evidence counts and accepted-rule boundary
names a concrete next delivery action
states that no owner decision is needed
